title: Turning on Deactivate parts adds a checkbox column at the left edge
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory parts {Part-A}, {Part-B} and {Part-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-COLUMN-01 to -03) are active and tracked at {Location-A}, with quantity 5 each.
  • Their part numbers start with {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-COLUMN).
  • Every column is switched on in the columns icon, and the browser window is narrow enough that the Inventory table scrolls sideways (for example 1280 pixels wide).
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Type {Prefix-A} in the Search box.
  3. Drag the table's sideways scrollbar all the way to the right.
  4. Click the ⋮ actions menu button in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  5. Click Deactivate parts.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: The table shows its right-most columns, and the Description column is out of view.
  • Step 5: The table scrolls back to its left edge on its own, and a new narrow column with a checkbox on every row (and one in the header) is the first column, in view.
  • Step 5: The column is just wide enough for the checkbox. Its exact width (44 pixels) cannot be measured by eye: write "column width not checked by hand" in the result comment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S2-R4, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.2 (Mode on), 13 Oct copy.
